about: Stick-figure 'What If' explainers. Pip is the only character. Each shot is one scene clip: pick a scene, then its options. Every option below is a closed list: the director must not invent values.

scenes.stage: Pip in a room, optionally holding a prop. Use for most shots.
scenes.insert: Extreme close-up following Pip's hand and the prop. Use for the object or action that matters.
scenes.title: Title card with up to 4 lines and one rule line. First shot only.
scenes.fact: Big count-up number with a label. Use for the one number the video is about.

options.pose2: same list as pose; Pip moves into it at `at` with a springy overshoot
options.at: 0..1, when pose2 happens in the clip (default 0.4)
options.to: walk target x; with pose 'walk' Pip crosses the frame
options.action: short mono tag at the top, 1 to 3 words, e.g. 'copy'
options.readout: big number that pops in, e.g. '13 min'
options.title: title scene only: array of lines, each 18 characters or fewer is best
options.rule: title scene only: the one rule of the video, short
options.label: fact scene only: what the number is

pacing: Cut every 1.5 to 3 seconds. Vary shot size on every cut. Never use the same room and shot twice in a row. Hold a wide shot at most 3 seconds.
